# Hägerstrand om Stegra: ”Tecken att man är riktigt illa ute”

**Feed**: borslunch  
**Published**: 2026-09-30  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This Börslunch episode starts with Konjunkturinstitutet's upgraded Swedish GDP forecast of 3%. Growth is broad-based, with consumers, industry and now exports all contributing, but inflation from energy prices is expected to push the Riksbank into rate hikes, possibly in November. Chief editor Anders Hägerstrand calls the CEO change at the unlisted steelmaker Stegra (Håkan Buskhe replacing Henrik Henriksson) and its reported need for at least SEK 10bn more a sign the company is in serious trouble and could end up like Northvolt. The panel also discusses a lukewarm IPO window (Nordamps fell 40% on its debut), Skistar's pricing power and Hemnet's competitive decline.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 SKIS-B — Skistar | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Guest Bornold calls Skistar a good stock with strong pricing power; record booking position, higher dividend and the stock up ~6% on the report.

#### Reasoning

Guest Joakim Bornold (Lervik/Söderberg & Partners) praises Skistar's ability to raise prices consistently thanks to a very strong product. The CEO cites the best booking position ever (+3%), sales doubled in five years, and new revenue streams. A weaker krona and a recovering consumer support demand. No explicit buy call was made, but the view is clearly positive.

#### Sell Triggers

- if bookings weaken ahead of the winter season
- if price hikes start to hurt occupancy
- if Riksbank hikes squeeze consumer purchasing power

> *"Men det är en bra aktie. De gör det ju väldigt, väldigt bra måste man säga"*

---

### ⛔ HEM — Hemnet | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Bornold expects Hemnet to struggle to recover after Booli's competition broke its monopoly; low valuation may be a value trap.

#### Reasoning

Bornold says Hemnet's monopoly is broken: estate agents are not on its side, apps are easy to build and the market is fragmenting. Competitors charge less, so earnings power is structurally weaker. A low valuation, returning major owners and a cost-saving plan to copy Booli do not convince him, since 'aktier som fortsätter bli billiga'.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Hemnet regains listing volumes and estate agent support
- if the free-listing model wins back market share

> *"Men jag tror det blir svårt för dem att komma tillbaka."*

---

### 🔴 SINCH — Sinch | **SELL** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Cited analyst view: Pareto has a sell rating on Sinch, saying it is hard to see what drives further growth acceleration; stock falls.

#### Reasoning

News item quoting Pareto's sell recommendation, which is analyst opinion, not the hosts' own view. The rationale is a lack of visible catalysts for faster growth.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Sinch shows organic growth accelerating
- if Pareto upgrades

> *"de backar efter att Pareto säljstämplat aktien med motiveringen att det är svårt att se vad som ska driva en fortsatt tillväxtökning"*

---

### 🟢 SAVE — Nordnet | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Cited analyst view: JP Morgan resumed coverage of Nordnet with overweight, target price SEK 401.

#### Reasoning

News item: JP Morgan restarted coverage with an overweight rating and a SEK 401 target. This is analyst opinion, not the hosts' view. The stock rose on the news.

#### Sell Triggers

- if JP Morgan downgrades
- if trading activity drops

> *"JP Morgan har återupptagit bevakning av internetbanken Nordnet med rådet övervikt och riktkursen 401 kronor."*
